world.units: world px (3x of the 1280×720 design units)
world.tileToWorld: x = 1920 + (col-row)*78 ;  y = 900 + (col+row)*39   (top corner of tile col,row)
world.footprintCentre: P(col + w/2, row + d/2) using the formula above with fractional col/row

a.name: view (room-screen-a-v3)

worldLayerPt.note: screen pt incl. status bar; content-relative top = top-103

a.tileToScreen: x = 191.27 + (col-row)*19.24;  y = 364.00 + (col+row)*9.62   (tile TOP corner, screen pt)

b.name: edit (room-screen-b-v3)

worldLayerPt.note: screen pt incl. status bar; content-relative top = top-103

b.tileToScreen: x = 194.93 + (col-row)*21.84;  y = 291.67 + (col+row)*10.92   (tile TOP corner, screen pt)

depthSort: Draw order: base-bg → walls → floor → edit tiles → rug decals → contact shadows → wall items → string lights → floor items sorted by key=(col+w-1)+(row+d-1) ascending (front-most tile), tie → smaller (col-row) first (left first), then smaller footprint area first → lamp glow (additive) → front puffs → selection UI.
collision: Floor items (except decals like rug) occupy footprint tiles exclusively; footprint must stay within 0..7. Rug may overlap anything.

L.axis: row (tile 0..7 from back corner toward left end)

R.axis: col (0..7 from back corner toward right end)

wallSlots.note: PLACEHOLDER: wall items use wallPosWorldPx from the layout; slot/span is approximate for future snapping. Wall items are not draggable in v1 (suggested).

contactShadow: per floor item: ellipse at footprint centre +2 units down, rx = 26*0.62*(w+d), ry = 13*0.62*(w+d) units (lamp 15×6, yarn 9×4), fill #2A1530 @ .32, blur 3 units (=9 world px). Generate in code so it follows moves; world/contact-shadows.svg is the default layout baked.
selectedLift: selected item sprite lifts 4 units (12 world px); footprint outline drawn on top
